Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered at times that are sufficiently distinct to allow for independent acknowledgment of each alarm.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the alarm data further comprises a status of acknowledgment for each triggered alarm.
